subject: Re: line's transparency in the geom_smooth function of ggplot2

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: line's transparency in the geom_smooth function of ggplot2
parts:
Here's a toy example:

DF <- data.frame(x = seq(10), y = 0.5 + 0.6 * seq(10) + rnorm(10))

library(ggplot2)
library(scales) # where the alpha() function lives
ggplot(DF, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm")
last_plot() + geom_smooth(aes(y = y + 5), method = "lm", alpha = 0.2,
color = alpha("blue", 0.1))

Dennis
